有什么可以帮忙的？

Create a real image asset sheet for a DevCompass Racing Jumbotron horse-racing live screen.




Subject: nine small status badge icons for horse racing entries, designed to overlay near white futuristic rider sprites on a clean white and ice-blue race track background.




Canvas and output: square 2048 x 2048 image, transparent-background look or very light neutral background, high resolution, crisp edges. Arrange the icons in a clean 3 x 3 grid with enough padding. Each icon should be visually distinct but share one coherent style.




Style: bright white / silver / pearl white base, ice blue glow accents, small gold highlights, clean futuristic racing broadcast style, Q-version stage prop feeling, polished but readable at small size. Match a white futuristic track background and white rider assets. Keep icons simple and bold.




Required nine icons, one per motion state:

1 idle: calm pause badge, subtle dot or standby mark

2 running: forward motion badge, medium speed streak

3 sprinting: fast burst badge, stronger speed lines

4 slowed: deceleration badge, soft downward chevrons

5 blocked: warning obstacle badge, amber barrier mark
